channel.title: ByteByteGo Newsletter
channel.description: Explain complex systems with simple terms, from the authors of the best-selling system design book series. Join over 1,000,000 friendly readers.

item.title: 【How Grab is Using AI Agents to Boost Team Productivity】Grab 如何使用人工智能代理来提高团队生产力
item.description: 【Grab’s data engineering team had a problem that looks familiar to anyone who’s maintained shared infrastructure.】Grab 的数据工程团队遇到了一个对于任何维护共享基础设施的人来说都很熟悉的问题。

item.title: 【EP215: The Anatomy of an AI Agent】EP215：人工智能代理的剖析
item.description: 【An AI agent can be thought of as a simple While-loop.】AI 代理可以被认为是一个简单的 While 循环。

item.title: 【LAST CALL FOR ENROLLMENT: Become an AI Engineer - Cohort 6】最后报名：成为一名人工智能工程师 - 第 6 组
item.description: 【Our 6th cohort of Becoming an AI Engineer starts tomorrow, Saturday, May 16. This is a live, cohort-based course created in collaboration with best-selling author Ali Aminian and published by ByteByteGo.】我们的第 6 期“成为人工智能工程师”课程将于明天（即 5 月 16 日星期六）开始。这是一门与畅销书作家 Ali Aminian 合作创建并由 ByteByteGo 出版的实时、基于群组的课程。

item.title: 【A Guide To Event-Driven Architectural Patterns】事件驱动架构模式指南
item.description: 【Distributed systems are built out of services that need to communicate, and the simplest way to do that is for one service to call another directly and wait for a response.】分布式系统是由需要通信的服务构建的，最简单的方法是一个服务直接调用另一个服务并等待响应。

item.title: 【High Performance Rate Limiting at Databricks】Databricks 的高性能速率限制
item.description: 【In this article, we look at how Databricks implemented rate limiting at scale, how they shrank the critical path, and the accuracy tradeoff that shrinking usually requires.】在本文中，我们将了解 Databricks 如何大规模实施速率限制、它们如何缩小关键路径以及缩小通常需要的准确性权衡。

item.title: 【How Figma Upgraded Data Pipeline from Multi-Day Latency to Real-Time】Figma 如何将数据管道从多天延迟升级为实时
item.description: 【In this article, we will learn what happened as Figma grew and how its engineering team handled the growth in terms of the data pipeline issues.】在本文中，我们将了解 Figma 的发展过程中发生了什么，以及其工程团队如何处理数据管道问题的增长。

item.title: 【How Pinterest Built a Production MCP Ecosystem】Pinterest 如何构建生产 MCP 生态系统
item.description: 【In this article, we look at how Pinterest designed that ecosystem and what they had to get right beyond the protocol itself.】在本文中，我们将了解 Pinterest 如何设计该生态系统，以及他们必须在协议本身之外实现哪些目标。

item.title: 【EP214: Claude Code vs. OpenClaw: 5 Design Dimensions】EP214：Claude Code 与 OpenClaw：5 个设计维度
item.description: 【Both are highly capable, but they have key architectural differences.】两者都具有很强的能力，但它们在架构上存在关键差异。

item.title: 【Become an AI Engineer | Enrollment Ends Soon 】成为一名人工智能工程师 |报名即将结束
item.description: 【Our 6th cohort of Becoming an AI Engineer starts in about a week.】我们的第六期成为人工智能工程师课程将在大约一周后开始。

item.title: 【Container Design Patterns for Distributed Systems】分布式系统的容器设计模式
item.description: 【In this article, we’ll walk through the patterns that have crystallized over the past decade, organized by the scope of their coordination.】在本文中，我们将按协调范围组织介绍过去十年中具体化的模式。
